Chemical substances like nitric acid and phosphorus are known and usable
No forensic DNA or advanced fingerprinting techniques

surface_summary: The cases appear as baffling mysteries involving locked cells, gas poisoning, missing persons, haunted houses, bank robberies, and attempted murders. Each case presents seemingly impossible circumstances and multiple suspects with motives and opportunities.
accepted_facts: Professor Van Dusen was locked in Cell 13 and escaped within a week.
Weldon Henley was nearly killed by gas poisoning and later shot.
The Ralston National Bank was robbed with the safe blown open.
Grace Field, the model for 'Fulfillment,' disappeared mysteriously.
inferred_conclusions: Van Dusen escaped by sheer mental power without external help.
Regnault Cabell was responsible for the attempts on Henley's life.
mechanism_description: Professor Van Dusen escaped Cell 13 by using a hidden old drain pipe to communicate with an accomplice outside, who aided him by cutting the prison's arc light feed wire with acid, allowing Van Dusen to slip out disguised as an electrician. Jean, the valet, used a Turkish bath robe and a mirror on a flagpole to watch Henley and extinguish his gas light by blowing into the gas pipe from an adjacent apartment, accidentally killing Louise Regnier and later shooting Henley. Louise Clarke planned and assisted in the Ralston Bank robbery using violet perfume to mislead scent evidence and chemical solution to weaken granite around bars. Constans St. George held Grace Field captive using chloroform and attacked Victor Willis, who had threatened her.
delivery_path: Van Dusen discovered a disused drain pipe in Cell 13 used by rats.
He sent a note tied to a rat through the pipe to a reporter.
The reporter found the pipe's exit and helped Van Dusen pull in a line.
Van Dusen used acid to cut the arc light feed wire near his cell.
He escaped through the window during the resulting darkness, disguised as a workman.
Jean used a mirror on a flagpole to watch Henley and blew out his gas light.
Louise Clarke used violet perfume and chemical solution to facilitate the bank robbery.
outcome_result: All mysteries were solved by Professor Van Dusen, revealing the true culprits and the ingenious methods they used.

false_assumption.statement: Van Dusen escaped Cell 13 solely by mental power without any outside assistance.
false_assumption.why_it_seems_reasonable: Van Dusen is portrayed as a brilliant logician who claims he can think his way out of any cell, and the prison authorities believe the cell is escape-proof. The mysterious notes and apparent impossibility of communication support this belief.
false_assumption.what_it_hides: The actual escape involved physical assistance via a hidden drain pipe and an accomplice outside who cut the arc light feed wire, enabling Van Dusen to escape disguised as a workman.

supporting_points: Cabell had a motive due to rivalry over Miss Lipscomb.
He was seen hurriedly packing to leave town after Henley was shot.
The scarlet thread matched his bath robe.
His valet was suspicious and had access.
false_solution.the_one_flaw: Cabell was out of town during the critical times and had no opportunity to commit the crimes.

red_herrings.description: Cabell's rivalry over Miss Lipscomb and his sudden departure suggest guilt.
red_herrings.innocent_explanation: Cabell was out of town and his valet was the actual culprit.

red_herrings.description: Curtis's jealousy and possession of the murder weapon implicate him in Marguerite Melrose's death.
red_herrings.innocent_explanation: Marguerite Melrose was alive and married to Don MacLean; the murder victim was Elizabeth Dow.

closed_circle.rationale: All suspects had opportunity and motive within their respective cases, and the investigation was confined to these individuals due to the closed settings and limited access.

discriminating_test.design: Reenact the escape from Cell 13 by simulating the conditions and testing the drain pipe communication and the cutting of the arc light feed wire with acid. Observe if the prisoner can exit the cell and prison undetected using the described method.
discriminating_test.knowledge_revealed: Confirms the physical means of escape via the drain pipe and external assistance, disproving the theory of mental escape alone.
discriminating_test.pass_condition: Successful exit from the cell and prison using the drain pipe and acid cutting method without detection.

fair_play_explanation: The reader is given detailed descriptions of the prison layout, the drain pipe, the notes sent, and the presence of the arc light feed wire near the cell window. The chemical properties of acid and the use of rats for message delivery are explained. Similarly, in other cases, clues such as the scarlet thread, the mirror on the flagpole, the perfume scent on the handkerchief, and the handwriting samples are all presented. Logical deduction and careful attention to these clues allow the reader to solve the mysteries alongside the detective.
